reddit.title: Introducing New Movement Mechanics in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share some significant updates to our movement mechanics in Provincia! In our latest devtalk, we discuss how formations now drag in the direction you pull, and how attacks from behind will now re-slot instead of wheeling through ranks. This means no more teleporting soldiers — they will slide into position, creating a more immersive experience. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march

steam.title: New Movement Mechanics in Provincia
steam.body: We're thrilled to introduce new movement mechanics that will enhance your gameplay in Provincia! Soldiers will now slide into formation rather than teleporting, and attacks from behind will re-slot instead of wheeling through ranks. This update aims to provide a more realistic and engaging experience. For more details, check out our devtalk here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march
